rules.coverage_text: Guidance does not state coverage limits; applies to rental units covered by the ordinance.

key_values.text: 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change

key_values.name: current_max_increase
key_values.text: 2.87 percent is the maximum allowable rent increase for the period of September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027.

rules.quote: The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases may not exceed the lesser of 3% or 80% of the CPI change. The current maximum is 2.87% for Sept 1, 2026 through Aug 31, 2027.
rules.title: Annual maximum rent increase

rules.cite: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.coverage_text: Guidance does not state coverage limits; applies to units covered by the ordinance.
rules.quote: Your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you.
rules.requirement: Landlords must have a valid reason to evict, such as nonpayment, lease breach, or landlord move-in. Relocation assistance may be owed for certain evictions.
rules.title: Just cause eviction
